Subject: Evening office hours — multi-customer demo coordination

Hi Elena / Marcus / Priya —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood's inference stack. We heard from a few teams that evening Pacific / late morning Eastern slots are easiest to coordinate across teams, so we're putting together a short group office hours/demo next week to walk through:

- How the Redwood runtime reduces tail latency for chat workloads
- Quick configuration walkthrough (batching, caching, quantization tradeoffs)
- Q&A + short 10-min breakout for technical deep-dive per team

Proposed window: Tuesday 2026-09-08, 5:30–6:30pm PT. Please pick whichever option works best for you in this Calendly link (slots are 60m, we'll cap at 3 external orgs): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/evening-office-hours-60

If that slot doesn't work, reply with a few times you prefer and we'll try to accommodate. We'll send a calendar invite once teams confirm. Agenda and a short deck will be attached.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
